statuses.summary: The installed marketplace and project contract are current.
actions: No upgrade action is required.

statuses.summary: An upgrade is required and all preflight checks passed.
actions: Review and approve a deterministic upgrade plan.

statuses.summary: An upgrade is required but one or more safety checks block mutation.
actions: Resolve every reported blocker.
Return a clean checkout to the configured target branch.
When the default-branch requirement is the only blocker, prepare the upgrade branch through the PMO command and continue in the same session.

statuses.summary: A fingerprint-bound plan is ready for final approval.
actions: Review the plan id and exact changes.
Approve or stop without mutation.

statuses.summary: Project instruction migration requires explicit owner choices before a plan can be created.
actions: Review every exact content preview.
Resolve each request with preserve, discard, or abort.
Run upgrade plan again with the selected choice ids.

statuses.summary: The owner aborted project instruction migration without creating a plan.
actions: No project or database mutation occurred.

statuses.summary: An upgrade owns the maintenance lock.
actions: Do not start normal marketplace work.
Wait for completion or follow recovery guidance.

statuses.summary: A durable journal records an incomplete upgrade.
actions: Run the recorded recovery path before any other marketplace mutation.

statuses.summary: The upgrade completed, but the current session still holds pre-upgrade runtime context.
actions: Close this session before staging.
Start a fresh session on the same upgrade branch.
Finish the exact managed-file commit and pull request there.

statuses.summary: Managed project upgrade files are not yet present on the configured target branch.
actions: Review the exact managed-file diff.
Commit only the planned files.
Push and merge the project upgrade pull request.
Update the target branch and start a fresh session from the merged revision.
